description: This file defines a report parser class for POS details in an Odoo module, including methods to calculate totals, discounts, taxes, and generate report context.

classes.name: pos_details
classes.description: A report parser class for POS details, providing methods to compute totals, discounts, taxes, and report context.

methods.name: _get_qty_total
methods.description: Calculates total quantity from a list of order objects.

methods.name: _get_sum_discount
methods.description: Calculates total discount value from a list of order objects.

methods.name: _get_payments
methods.description: Aggregates payment amounts, optionally ignoring gift payments.

methods.name: _paid_total
methods.description: Calculates total paid amount, ignoring gift payments.

methods.name: _total_of_the_day
methods.description: Calculates net total for the day by subtracting invoiced amount from total paid.

methods.name: _sum_invoice
methods.description: Sums total invoice amounts from order objects.

methods.name: _ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length with ellipsis.

methods.name: _strip_name
methods.description: Truncates a name string to 50 characters with ellipsis.

methods.name: _get_tax_amount
methods.description: Calculates tax amounts per tax name from order lines.

methods.name: _get_sales_total
methods.description: Counts total number of sale lines across orders.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Returns the date period covered by the orders.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser and sets up the local context with methods and utilities.
